title: Log
description: Log the current status of the dataframe.

recipe_writer.reason: Operational logging steps are not authored in the baseline.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: (Optional, default all columns) List of specific columns to log.

parameters.name: write
parameters.description: (Optional) Allows for an intermediate output to a file/dataframe/database etc.

parameters.name: warning
parameters.description: Log a warning to the console.

parameters.name: log_data
parameters.description: Whether to log a sample of the contents of the dataframe. Default True if not logging to a write, error, warning or info. Default False otherwise.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Log an error to the console.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Print the current status of the dataframe. Only a sample of rows is logged. ## Migrated examples #### Logging All Columns to Terminal ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - log: {} ```
##### Input Sample _Logging side-effect; no tabular input sample._
##### Output Sample _Logs a sample of rows or status information to the configured destination._
#### Logging Specific Columns to Terminal ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - log: columns: - column1 - column2 ```
##### Input Sample _Logging side-effect; no tabular input sample._
##### Output Sample _Logs a sample of rows or status information to the configured destination._
#### Logging to a File ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - log: write: - file: name: output/filepath columns: - column 1 - column 2 ```
##### Input Sample _Logging side-effect; no tabular input sample._
##### Output Sample _Logs a sample of rows or status information to the configured destination._
#### Native Variables | Variable | Function | | --- | --- | | `${column_count}` | Number of columns. | | `${columns}` | List of all columns. | | `${df}` | Current dataframe. | | `${row_count}` | Number of visible rows processed in each batch. |
